guard: Bootstrap membership renewal starts with actual broker-refused expired credentials and reaches the stock membership renewal path

mutations.name: leave the initial membership credential fresh
mutations.expectRed: membership-rw renewal starts with a broker-refused expired credential
mutations.cell: membership-rw renewal starts with a broker-refused expired credential

mutations.name: omit membership credentials from stock daemon renewal
mutations.find: { kind: MEMBERSHIP_RW_CREDS_KIND, key: (space) => segmentedKey(MEMBERSHIP_RW_CREDS_KIND, space), profile: "membership-rw" },
mutations.expectRed: stock remint renews the membership-rw cred separately through the injected store after broker preflight
mutations.cell: stock remint renews the membership-rw cred separately through the injected store after broker preflight
